title: [4k, 60 fps] San Francisco, a Trip down Market Street, April 14, 1906
summary: A neural-network upscaled 4K, 60 fps version of the 1906 film of a trip down Market Street in San Francisco, shot four days before the earthquake. It shows cable cars, horse carriages, early automobiles and pedestrians sharing the street.
why: Cited in threads on cars, streets and urbanism as evidence of how mixed traffic worked before cars took over.

quote.text: You can see pedestrians, horse-drawn carriages, and early automobiles all "flowing" together.
